description: The 90 deg open-channel junction of Weber et al. (2001) on three blocks (W/dx 8): the main channel downstream of the junction block 0 with the native outflow, the main channel upstream and the junction block 1 with its inflow (G 54 1 1), the branch block 2 with its inflow (G 54 2 1) on a part of block 1's +j face; a vertex of three blocks at the downstream corner of the branch; the parabolic eddy viscosity (A 260 4).
covers: the partial interface of block 1 and the vertex of three blocks with the inflow of two blocks
